mentions.name: Superchat
mentions.description: A chat app and server built to use as little network as possible, so that even dial-up connections work fine. Development is heavily assisted by Claude Code.
mentions.problem: Designed to use as little network as possible, so chat works fine even over low-bandwidth connections like dial-up.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a chat app/server and protocol builder to support it, in an attempt to use as little network as possible (e.g. dial-up should work fine).

It's heavily supported by Claude Code, but much fun.

https://superchat.win/
